# JoyDeviceConnected

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Joystick](BlitzBasic-Joystick)

</div>


```blitzbasic
JoyDeviceConnected:Int32 port:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `port` | In | Int32 | required | The port to ask, counted from 0. |

**Returns:** 1 if a joystick is connected to the port, otherwise 0.

## Description

Tells if the joystick of a port is still plugged in. A joystick that was removed leaves its port not connected, and plugging it in again gives it a new port.

## Differences

* This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Repeat
	Cls
	For p = 0 To JoyDeviceCount() - 1
		Text 10, 10 + p * 16, JoyDeviceName(p) + ": " + JoyDeviceConnected(p)
	Next
	Flip
Until KeyHit(1)
```
